UpdateSourceData:
# Generated by AMP on every start. Changes made here are lost: use the AMP settings.
# Secrets and tokens are kept in the secrets folder.
metadata_dir = "{{$FullBaseDir}}meta"
data_dir = "{{$FullBaseDir}}data"
db_engine = "{{DbEngine}}"
metadata_auto_snapshot_interval = "{{SnapshotInterval}}"
replication_factor = 1
compression_level = {{CompressionLevel}}

rpc_bind_addr = "{{$ApplicationIPBinding}}:{{$RpcPort}}"
rpc_public_addr = "127.0.0.1:{{$RpcPort}}"
rpc_secret_file = "{{$FullBaseDir}}secrets/rpc_secret"

[s3_api]
s3_region = "{{S3Region}}"
api_bind_addr = "{{$ApplicationIPBinding}}:{{$S3Port}}"
root_domain = "{{S3RootDomain}}"

[s3_web]
bind_addr = "{{$ApplicationIPBinding}}:{{$WebPort}}"
root_domain = "{{WebRootDomain}}"
index = "index.html"

[admin]
api_bind_addr = "{{$ApplicationIPBinding}}:{{$AdminPort}}"
admin_token_file = "{{$FullBaseDir}}secrets/admin_token"
{{MetricsTokenLine}}metrics_token_file = "{{$FullBaseDir}}secrets/metrics_token"
